newsitem.title: USA: Oracle stock up after earnings report.
newsitem.headline: Oracle stock up after earnings report.

text.p: Oracle Corp.'s stock rose in heavy trading Friday, a day after it reported first-quarter earnings that were exactly in line with analysts' expectations.
The stock was up $3.75 to $41.125 on volume of 6.1 million shares.

Oracle said after the market closed Thursday that its first-quarter net income soared 110 percent to $113 million, or 17 cents per share, compared with profits of $54 million, or 8 cents per share the previous year.
Oracle, based in Redwood City, Calif., is the world's second-largest software company, making database and Internet software.
